project: Smart Mess & KFC Express • KIET Campus OS
architectureStyle: Decoupled Multi-Tier SPA + Reactive Broadcast Sync + RESTful Microservices + Heuristic AI Time-Series Regression

components.name: User Actors (8 Campus Personas)
components.description: 8 distinct campus personas: Student, Room Lead, Floor Incharge, Block Coordinator, Mess Incharge, KFC Staff, Principal, and System Admin.

components.name: React Frontend Core & Routing
components.description: Vite 6 Single Page Application with React Router v6, Lucide React icons, and Tailwind CSS v4 styling.

components.name: ProtectedRoute Client Route Guard
components.description: Role-based route authorization guard that intercepts unauthenticated users and redirects to /login. Verifies allowed roles across all 8 dashboard routes (student, room-lead, floor-incharge, block-coordinator, mess-incharge, kfc-staff, principal, admin) against AppContext session before rendering sensitive views.

components.name: State & Synchronization Engine (AppContext)
components.description: Central state management engine maintaining optimistic updates, local storage cache, instant cross-tab real-time sync via BroadcastChannel('smart_mess_tab_sync'), audio chimes, and REST dispatchers.

components.name: Student Engagement & Diet Portal
components.description: Student meal planner with 4-meal opt-in/opt-out toggles, portion preferences (Full, Half, Light), sick diet requisition submission, meal history, and notification feeds.

components.name: KFC Express Canteen & Live Queue
components.description: Interactive digital food court catalog with category filters, cart drawer, automated token generation (KFC-302-XX), live 4-stage order pipeline (Pending -> Preparing -> Ready -> Collected), and front-counter fulfillment screen.

components.name: Room Lead Verification & Leave Tracker
components.description: Hostel room occupant audit for all 8 rooms in Blocks D & E, leave tracking with portion deductions, roommate nudges, sick occupant tagging, and room roster submission to Floor Incharge.

components.name: Floor Incharge Supervision & Requisitions
components.description: Floor-level hostel administration across Floors D-1, D-2, E-1, and E-2. Aggregates room headcounts into official Floor Meal Sheets (Veg, Non-Veg, Sick Trays) dispatched to the Mess Kitchen.

components.name: Block Coordinator & Consolidation Lock
components.description: Multi-floor aggregation for Block D & Block E, formal Block Consolidation Lock mechanism (cutoff at 10:30 AM), coordinator directives dispatcher, and kitchen turnout variance audit.

components.name: Mess Incharge Command Hub & AI Forecasting Hub
components.description: Comprehensive kitchen command hub featuring the 6-Tier Relations Matrix (Student, Principal, Room, KFC, Floor, Block), 4 cooking stations batch tracker, daily menu publisher, campus broadcaster, and the interactive AI Headcount Forecasting Hub (14-day historical WMA regression, Recharts 7-day actual vs predicted turnout fit, interactive What-If scenario simulation with real-time sliders, automated kitchen store batch requisition generator, and real-time anomaly alerts).

components.name: Principal Omniscient Command Center
components.description: Institutional executive dashboard featuring 360° campus visibility across all 5 tiers, Executive Connect Bar with 1-click inspection into any operational dashboard, Universal Directive Dispatcher, and Unified Live Pulse event stream.

components.name: Admin Console & Database Seeder
components.description: User role management, account status toggles, database seeder triggers, MongoDB connectivity monitor, and institutional public landing page.

components.name: Vite Reverse Proxy Gateway
components.description: Reverse proxy routing `/api/*` traffic seamlessly from Vite dev server (port 3000) to Express backend (port 5000).

components.name: Node.js / Express Server Core
components.description: Express 4 REST API engine listening on port 5000 with CORS, JSON body parser, MongoDB connection, and in-memory seed dataset fallback.

components.name: REST API Controller & Multi-Tier Routing
components.description: Handles 30+ REST endpoints across User Auth, Menu CRUD, Selections, KFC Orders/Menu, Directives, Floor Requisitions, Room Requisitions, Block Consolidations, Campus Broadcasts, Dietary Requests, and AI Forecasting (/api/ai/forecast, /api/ai/historical, /api/ai/simulate, /api/ai/anomalies).

components.name: MongoDB & Mongoose Schemas Layer
components.description: Mongoose ORM defining 18 collections: Student, Room, MealSelection, Menu, KFCOrder, KFCMenuItem, User, Notification, Wastage, BlockPerformance, Attendance (stores 14-day historical dining attendance for AI training/regression), Aggregation, Anomaly, Directive, FloorRequisition, RoomRequisition, BlockConsolidation, MessBroadcast, DietaryRequest.

components.name: AI Headcount Forecasting & Kitchen Batch Intelligence Engine
components.description: Dual-layer predictive intelligence engine (integrated Express controller + Python FastAPI microservice on port 8000) that models student dining behavior using 14-day historical time-series regression. Implements Weighted Moving Average (WMA weights: [0.30, 0.22, 0.16, 0.12, 0.09, 0.06, 0.05]), Day-of-Week Seasonality factor C_dow (Mon: 1.04, Fri: 0.96, Sun: 0.88, etc.), and Turnout Conversion Ratio (102.8% - 103.8%). Directly derives Kitchen Store Batch Sizing for raw materials (Rice kg, Dal kg, Veg kg, Rotis count, Safety Buffer kg). Powers interactive What-If scenario simulations (weather impact, exam season, headcount variance) and detects operational anomalies (>12% variance, turnout surges, deficit risks).

unverifiedOrAbsentComponents.name: LangChain & High-Latency Neural LLMs
unverifiedOrAbsentComponents.status: DELIBERATELY REPLACED WITH STATISTICAL REGRESSION (Sub-10ms WMA & Seasonality Engine)
unverifiedOrAbsentComponents.evidence: Kitchen operations require 100% deterministic, low-latency (<10ms) batch calculations. The system purposefully implements 14-day Weighted Moving Average time-series regression and kitchen batch requisition math in both Express and FastAPI rather than non-deterministic, high-latency LLM calls.

unverifiedOrAbsentComponents.name: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
unverifiedOrAbsentComponents.status: NOT REQUIRED (Time-series numerical dataset utilized directly)
unverifiedOrAbsentComponents.evidence: Dining headcount prediction operates on structured 14-day attendance logs in MongoDB rather than unstructured text documents.

unverifiedOrAbsentComponents.name: ChromaDB / Vector Database
unverifiedOrAbsentComponents.status: NOT REQUIRED (MongoDB Attendance collection stores structured historical logs)
unverifiedOrAbsentComponents.evidence: Historical turnouts, dates, meal types, and variance metrics are efficiently indexed and queried via MongoDB / Mongoose schemas.

runtimeFlows.name: Student Meal Selection & Portion Sizing Flow

steps.action: Authenticates using Roll Number as password
login() initializes session in state and localStorage
Selects meal opt-in/opt-out and portion preference (Full/Half/Light)
Updates local optimistic state, broadcasts on BroadcastChannel, locks submission
Dispatches HTTP POST /api/selections payload
Routes request to apiControllers.js (postSelections)
Persists selection against MealSelection schema

runtimeFlows.name: AI Headcount Forecasting & Kitchen Batch Intelligence Flow

steps.action: Navigates to the dedicated 'AI Headcount Forecast' Hub on /mess-incharge
Fetches 14-day historical dining attendance baseline across Mon-Sun
Computes Weighted Moving Average with weights [0.30, 0.22, 0.16, 0.12, 0.09, 0.06, 0.05] & Day-of-Week Seasonality factor (C_dow)
Automatically derives raw store batch requirements: Rice (0.18 kg/p), Dal (0.08 kg/p), Veg/Paneer (0.12 kg/p), Rotis (2.5x), and Safety Buffer (5-8%)
Adjusts interactive sliders (turnout variance, rainy weather, exam season) for instant risk recalculation
Scans for variance deviations >12% and displays operational warnings (turnout surge, unexpected dip, kitchen deficit)
Synchronizes recommended batch counts directly into Veg, Non-Veg, Snacks, and KFC prep stations

runtimeFlows.name: KFC Express Food Court Order-to-Fulfillment Flow

steps.action: Browses categorized menu catalog (Burgers, Krushers, Combos)
Adds items to cart and submits order
Generates unique pickup token (e.g. KFC-302-14) and decrements item stock
Broadcasts new order across all open browser tabs
Saves order record with status='Pending' into MongoDB
Receives order in Pending queue
Staff advances state: 'Pending' -> 'Preparing' -> 'Ready'
Plays audio chime and prompts student for counter collection

runtimeFlows.name: Hostel Hierarchy Rollup & Block Consolidation Lock Flow

steps.action: Audits 5 room occupants, verifies meal headcount, flags sick students
Submits room sheet to Floor Incharge via BroadcastChannel & PUT /api/mess/rooms/:roomNo
Verifies supervised rooms on floor (e.g. Floor D-1) and compiles Floor Meal Sheet
Dispatches floor requisition (Veg, Non-Veg, Sick Trays) to Mess Kitchen
Audits multi-floor rollups across Block D & Block E
Locks block headcount at 10:30 AM cutoff and sends POST /api/mess/block-consolidations
Receives locked consolidated rollups and begins cooking station batch scheduling
Issues official directive (e.g. '15% Extra Buffer for Interschool Hackathon')
Dispatches mandate to target operational tier
Broadcasts directive across tabs and plays high-priority audio alert
Clicks 'Acknowledge Directive', triggering POST /api/mess/principal-directives/:id/ack
Transmits kitchen buffer status and hygiene readiness report back to Principal
